# PT Misuba Guna Indonesia

> PT Misuba Guna Indonesia is an Indonesian industrial engineering supplier and plant maintenance contractor. It supplies expansion joints, sealing systems, corrosion protection linings and coatings, couplings, thermal equipment and pulp & paper machinery, and provides on-site repair, lining and maintenance services to industrial plants across Indonesia.

Prices, stock and lead times are quoted per enquiry; none are published on the website.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** PT Misuba Guna Indonesia
- **Website:** https://misubaguna.com/
- **Sales Email:** sales@misubaguna.com
- **Phone:** +62 21 55660700
- **WhatsApp:** +62 811-8715-671
- **Operational & Warehouse:** Ruko Mutiara Karawaci Blok C29, Bencongan Indah, Kelapa Dua, Tangerang, Banten 15810, Indonesia
- **Billing Office:** Gedung STC Senayan Lt. 4 Ruang 80, Jalan Asia Afrika Pintu IX Gelora Senayan, Gelora, Tanah Abang, Kota Adm. Jakarta Pusat, DKI Jakarta 10270, Indonesia
- **Industries Served:** Power generation, petrochemical, chemical processing, pulp & paper, palm oil, mining, water treatment, food & beverage, heavy manufacturing.
- **Languages:** English, Indonesian

- [Scientific & Engineering Calculator](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/calculator/): Online engineering calculator with unit conversion and mathematical functions.
- [Material Property Library](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/material-specs/): Searchable property database of industrial materials: steels, nickel alloys, elastomers, fluoropolymers, ceramics and gasket sheets.
- [Expansion Joint Selector](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/expansion-joint-selector/): Pipe thermal expansion calculator (axial growth, anchor thrust) with rubber, PTFE, metal and fabric expansion joint recommendation.
- [Chemical Resistance Guide](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/chemical-resistance/): Chemical compatibility chart for PTFE, EPDM, NBR, FKM (Viton), Neoprene, Hypalon, natural rubber, 316 stainless steel, ceramic and FRP against 40+ industrial chemicals.
- [EJMA Bellows Calculator](https://misubaguna.com/toolkit/ejma-bellows-calculator/): Online design check of metal bellows expansion joints (unreinforced, reinforced, toroidal) per EJMA Standards; results are reviewed by our engineering team.

# Detailed Technical Catalog & Service Directory

## All Industrial Products

### PTFE Lining
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-lining/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection > Lining
- **Summary:** Advanced fluoropolymer PTFE lining solutions applied to pipes, fittings, vessels, and chemical columns to provide an impermeable, non-stick chemical barrier against aggressive acids and high temperatures.
- **Key Features:** Complete chemical inertness against concentrated nitric, sulfuric, hydrochloric, and hydrofluoric acids up to 260°C; Thick-wall paste extruded PTFE liner prevents permeation and thermal vacuum collapse in continuous vacuum lines; Seamless flared-over sealing faces eliminate separate gaskets at pipe spool and vessel flange connections; Ultra-smooth non-stick surface coefficient prevents scaling, chemical fouling, and pressure drop in transfer lines; 100% Non-destructive electro-spark tested (20kV+ DC) to guarantee zero pinholes or micro-cracks before dispatch
- **Materials:** Liner Material: 100% Virgin PTFE, Conductive PTFE (Antistatic), PFA, FEP; Substrate Steel: Carbon Steel (A106 Gr B, A53), SS304, SS316L, ASTM A395 Ductile Iron fittings; Flange Standards: ANSI B16.5 Class 150/300, DIN EN 1092-1, JIS B2220
- **Applications:** Petrochemical acid wash columns, chlorine headers, and pickling acid recirculation loops; Agrochemical and fertilizer manufacturing acid feed lines; Pharmaceutical API synthesis reactors and high-purity solvent transfer lines; Power plant FGD (Flue Gas Desulfurization) chemical dosing and neutralization tanks; Palm oil oleochemical fatty acid distillation columns and chlor-alkali plants
- **How to buy:** Request a quotation from sales@misubaguna.com or WhatsApp +62 811-8715-671 with operating conditions and quantity.

### Rubber Lining
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/rubber-lining/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection > Lining
- **Summary:** Heavy-duty elastomeric rubber lining applications applied to tanks, pipes, slurry pumps, and process vessels for severe acid corrosion protection and coarse particle abrasion resistance.
- **Key Features:** Dual protection: Exceptional impact and slurry abrasion resistance combined with complete acid and alkali barrier protection; Available in soft rubber (40-60 Shore A) for high-velocity particle impact and hard ebonite (75-80 Shore D) for chemical immersion; Superior elastomeric flexibility dampens structural vibration and accommodates thermal contraction without cracking; High-bond strength adhesive system (>10 N/mm peel strength) prevents liner disbondment under vacuum or pressure swings; Cold-bonding site repair systems available for quick field maintenance of tank linings without autoclave requirement
- **Specifications:** Substrate Preparation: Grit blasting to ISO 8501-1 SA 2.5 profile (75-100 microns); Testing Standards: ASTM D429 (Adhesion), ASTM D5162 / NACE SP0188 (Spark holiday testing 5kV per mm); Temperature Limit: Soft Rubber (-30°C to +85°C); Butyl / EPDM (-30°C to +120°C)
- **Materials:** Rubber Compounds: Natural Rubber (Soft & Ebonite Hard), Chlorobutyl, Bromobutyl, EPDM, Neoprene, Synthetic NBR; Bonding System: Multi-layer chemlok/isocyanic adhesive primer systems; Lining Thickness: Standard 3mm, 4mm, 6mm, up to 25mm multi-ply build-up
- **Applications:** Mining ore slurry pipelines, hydrocyclones, flotation cells, and ball mill shells; Power plant FGD scrubber towers, slurry recirculation pumps, and gypsum slurry tanks; Phosphoric acid storage tanks, water treatment demineralizer vessels, and cation/anion beds; Chemical processing transport tankers, acid pickling vats, and waste neutralization pits; Palm oil mill effluent (POME) treatment tanks and coastal seawater intake pipes

- **Specifications:** Tile Thickness: 6mm, 10mm, 12.5mm, 20mm, 25mm, up to 50mm heavy block tiles; Hardness: Mohs Hardness 9 (Vickers HV10 ≥ 1100); Temperature Range: Epoxy bonded (up to 150°C); Weld-attached (up to 750°C)
- **Materials:** Ceramic Media: 92% Alumina (Al2O3), 95% Alumina, Zirconia-Toughened Alumina (ZTA), Silicon Carbide (SiC); Backing & Bonding: High-impact natural rubber matrix, Two-part high-temperature epoxy resin adhesive; Fixation Hardware: Weldable steel caps, Countersunk SS304 studs, Interlocking tongue-and-groove joints

### FRP Lining
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/frp-lining/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection > Lining
- **Summary:** Seamless glass-fiber reinforced plastic (FRP / GRP) composite lining systems applied on steel, concrete, and brick structures for heavy chemical, acid, and wastewater corrosion protection.
- **Key Features:** Custom resin selection (Vinyl Ester, Novolac, Isophthalic) matched to specific acid, solvent, or alkali exposure; Monolithic, jointless composite lining seals concrete cracks and prevents chemical seepage into surrounding groundwater; High mechanical strength-to-weight ratio allows structural rehabilitation of thin-wall corroded steel tanks; Integral C-glass synthetic surface veil provides a resin-rich (>80%) chemical barrier preventing fiber prominence; Excellent thermal expansion match with concrete and steel, preventing delamination during seasonal temperature cycles
- **Specifications:** Laminate Thickness: 3-ply (approx 3mm), 5-ply (approx 5mm), heavy duty 7-ply structural lining (>7mm); Barcol Hardness: ≥ 35 Barcol; Temperature Resistance: Up to 120°C continuous wet immersion depending on resin selection
- **Materials:** Resin Matrix: Novolac Vinyl Ester (Derakane 470/411), Bisphenol A, Premium Isophthalic Polyester; Reinforcement: E-glass Chopped Strand Mat (CSM 300/450/600 g/m²), Woven Roving (WR 600), C-glass surface veil; Primers: Moisture-tolerant epoxy primer for concrete, Silane-treated steel primer
- **Applications:** Chemical plant primary and secondary containment dikes, bund walls, and floor trenches; Wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) equalization tanks, clarifiers, and acid neutralization pits; Power plant demisalization water storage tanks and chemical dosing sumps; Pulp and paper chemical storage vessels and bleach plant effluent gutters; Electroplating acid rinse tanks and battery room floor protection

### Ceramic Coating
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ceramic-coating/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection > Coating
- **Summary:** Advanced liquid ceramic polymer coatings and thermal spray ceramic barriers applied to metal components to prevent high-temperature oxidation, cavitation, erosion, and chemical corrosion.
- **Key Features:** Restores cavitated pump impellers and volutes to original hydraulic efficiency, reducing power consumption; Ultra-smooth ceramic finish improves fluid hydrodynamic flow efficiency by up to 3-5% while preventing erosion; High micro-hardness ceramic particles protect pump casings and valve seats against severe particle impact and cavitation; Exhibits superior dielectric strength, eliminating galvanic corrosion between dissimilar metal assemblies; High thermal barrier properties protect boiler tubes and engine manifolds from high-temperature gas scaling
- **Specifications:** Coating Thickness: 500 microns to 3000 microns for liquid ceramic; 150-400 microns for thermal spray; Adhesion Strength: >20 MPa (Elcometer pull-off test on steel per ASTM D4541); Temperature Limit: Liquid Ceramic (up to 180°C wet / 230°C dry); Thermal Spray Ceramic (up to 900°C)
- **Materials:** Polymer Base: Ceramic-reinforced 100% solids epoxy matrix (solvent-free), Novolac epoxy ceramic; Ceramic Fillers: Micro-spherical Alumina (Al2O3), Silicon Carbide (SiC), Quartz flour; Thermal Spray Ceramics: Chromium Oxide (Cr2O3), Alumina-Titania (Al2O3-TiO2 87/13)
- **Applications:** Cooling water pump casings, impellers, suction bells, and cutlass bearing journals; Plate heat exchanger end plates, tube sheets, and water box covers; Slurry pump volutes, dredging pump components, and hydrocyclone bodies; Industrial control valves, butterfly valve discs, and sea chest strainers; Boiler economizer tubes, exhaust fan blades, and duct expansion sleeves

### PTFE Coating
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/ptfe-coating/
- **Category:** Corrosion Protection > Coating
- **Summary:** Precision industrial PTFE / Xylan fluoropolymer coating service applied to fasteners, valves, molds, and process components for non-stick release, low friction, and salt-spray corrosion protection.
- **Key Features:** Ultra-low coefficient of friction (0.05 to 0.10) prevents thread galling and breakout torque spikes on industrial stud bolts; Exceptional salt-spray corrosion resistance (>1500 to 3000+ hours ASTM B117 salt spray test) for offshore marine fasteners; Superior non-stick release properties prevent sticky polymer, rubber, food, or chemical residue adhesion on mold tooling; Chemically resistant to solvents, fuel, hydraulic fluids, and weathering without degrading or flaking; Food-contact compliant (FDA 21 CFR) formulations available for food processing and packaging machinery
- **Specifications:** Dry Film Thickness (DFT): 15 to 50 microns for fasteners; up to 100+ microns for heavy release/chemical duty; Corrosion Resistance: Exceeds 1,500 hours ASTM B117 salt spray without red rust; Continuous Temperature Rating: -195°C to +260°C (PTFE/PFA)
- **Materials:** Coating Systems: PTFE (Polytetrafluoroethylene), PFA, FEP, Xylan® 1014 / 1424 fluoropolymer resin matrices; Primer Layer: Zinc phosphate, Epoxy-polyamide primer, Chromate-free corrosion inhibitor primer; Substrate Compatibility: Carbon Steel, Alloy Steel (B7/B16), SS304/SS316, Inconel, Aluminum, Brass
- **Applications:** Offshore oil & gas subsea stud bolts, nuts, and flange fastener assemblies (Xylan coated ASTM A193 B7/B16); Chemical control valve plugs, ball valve spheres, and actuator internal components; Rubber and plastic molding dies, tire molds, and thermoforming tooling; Food & bakery dough hoppers, heat sealing jaws, and conveyor guide rails; Automotive fuel rail components, throttle shafts, and lock mechanisms

### Fabric Expansion Joint
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/fabric-expansion-joint/
- **Category:** Flexible Joint
- **Summary:** Custom non-metallic fabric expansion joints designed by PT Misuba Guna Indonesia for high-temperature ductwork, boiler exhaust lines, and severe vibration isolation.
- **Key Features:** Absorbs multi-directional thermal movement (axial, lateral, angular) without inducing spring rate stress on duct supports; Custom multi-layer composite belting tailored for continuous operating temperatures from 150°C to over 1000°C; Integrated ceramic fiber insulating belt protects gastight outer layers from direct thermal radiation; Easily field-welded or bolted to existing companion flanges with internal metal liner sleeves to prevent ash erosion; Zero maintenance fabric construction that eliminates fatigue cracking common in thin-gauge metal duct bellows
- **Specifications:** Duct Geometry: Custom round (DN200 to DN4000+) or rectangular (any aspect ratio); Operating Pressure: Low pressure ducting (-0.5 bar to +0.8 bar); Temperature Capability: Up to 1100°C continuous service with multi-layer ceramic insulation
- **Materials:** Outer Cover: Silicone-coated glass cloth, Fluoroelastomer canvas, EPDM; Gas Barrier: Solid PTFE sheet foil, PTFE-impregnated fiberglass; Thermal Insulation: Needle-felted ceramic fiber blanket, high-silica glass mat; Reinforcement & Liner: SS304/SS316 wire mesh, internal SS304 flow sleeve, carbon steel backing bars
- **Applications:** Power plant boiler flue gas and turbine exhaust ducting (PLTU, PLTG, PLTU Biomass); Cement plant kiln preheaters, calciner ducts, and raw mill dust extraction lines; Steel mill sintering lines and blast furnace flue gas ductwork; Petrochemical incinerators and flare stack gas lines; Industrial boiler ID fan and FD fan inlet/outlet isolation joints

### Metal Expansion Joint
- **URL:** https://misubaguna.com/product/metal-expansion-joint/

- **Summary:** High-precision stainless steel and high-alloy bellows expansion joints engineered for thermal expansion compensation in high-pressure steam, oil, and gas piping.
